structure.note: Class A shares (Nasdaq: TEAM) carry one vote and unlisted Class B shares carry ten votes. The two co-founders each hold 48,024,933 Class B shares (50.00% of Class B, 42.59% of total voting power each): Mike Cannon-Brookes through the Cannon-Brookes Head Trust and Scott Farquhar through Farquhar Investment Partnership No. 2. Neither alone holds more than 50% of the vote. Directors and executive officers as a group hold 85.21% of the vote. The FY2025 10-K says Class B holders collectively hold approximately 85% of the voting power.

CANNON-BROOKES: holds no Class A; his 48,024,933 Class B shares are 50.00% of Class B and 42.59% of total voting power. The proxy gives no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the derived figure is 18.24% of all shares. Relation is co-founder (the proxy calls him 'CEO and Co-Founder'). HOLDERS left empty: the proxy's 5% holders are measured as % of Class A only, a different basis from the leader's all-shares derived figure, and may not be converted. They are The Vanguard Group, 15,969,500 Class A (9.55% of Class A, 1.42% of voting power; Schedule 13G/A filed July 10, 2024, event date June 28, 2024: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1650372/000110465924078883/tv0023-atlassiancorpclassa.htm); BlackRock, 8,959,538 Class A (5.36%; Schedule 13G filed January 29, 2024, as of December 31, 2023: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1650372/000108636424005558/us0494681010_012924.txt); and Baillie Gifford & Co, 8,807,619 Class A (5.27%; filed January 30, 2024, as of 29 December 2023: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1650372/000108887524000049/atlassian29122023.txt). Co-founder Scott Farquhar holds 48,024,933 Class B (50.00% of Class B, 42.59% of votes), the same as Cannon-Brookes. He is not listed as a holder because the proxy gives no all-shares percentage for him either. DIVIDENDS: none in FY2025; the cash-flow statement has no dividend line. PLAN: null; the 10-K says the company 'currently does not have common stock outstanding or open offering periods under the ESPP'. GEOGRAPHY uses the leaf rows (U.S., Other Americas, Germany, Other EMEA, Asia Pacific), not the regional subtotals; the rounded values sum to 5.20 against the 5.22 total.
